sewer_metro_lines: Mind the drip. The pipes remember everything.
Sewer grate pops. Somebody slid in here before.
Grind the rail, not your teeth.
Metro doors closing. Kickflip now or wait.
Next stop: Tunnel Nine. Hold onto your board.
Echo check: your ollie sounds louder down here.
Track lights flicker. Duck the low beam.
Board snapped? Spare decks behind the pump room.
Storm drain run open. Speed is the only map.
Last train leaves at midnight. Skate faster.
Pipe gap ahead. Commit or swim.
Tagged a tunnel wall. Style points banked.
Metro guard is napping. Tiptoe on those wheels.
Daylight above. Manhole exit, three blocks up.
octagon_storefront: NPC: Eight walls, zero corners to hide in.
NPC: Grab a pretzel stick. Water taxi's late.
NPC: Best seat? Pick a wall. They're all good.
NPC: We fry it, you fly it. Napkins extra.
BLURB: Harbor eatery shaped like a stop sign.
BLURB: Famous for funnel fries and salt breeze.
BLURB: Built by a sailor who hated corners.
BLURB: Every window faces the harbor. Somehow.
bike_builder_ui: Ramp too steep. Lower the angle.
Mud pit placed. Bring a towel.
Stoop spot taken. Try next door.
Clear Track? This can't be undone.
sugar_elevator_lines: Freight elevator to the roof. Smells like syrup.
Going up. Sugar dust in every crack.
Cable groans. Hope the candy plant paid its bills.
Floor six: caramel vats. Do not lick the walls.
Doors jam halfway. Pry them with your mallet.
Lights die. Emergency brake glows pink.
Rooftop ahead. The sign is bigger up close.
Ding. Top floor. The whole harbor glitters.
